value.account:
WHAT CHANGED
- orchestrator/state.py: RunState.result_persistence_profile (validated in __post_init__, so construction, from_dict/load and StateManager.initialize all raise ValueError naming the profile). to_dict omits it when None. StateManager gains begin_eligible_pure_visit, reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit, settle_eligible_pure_success and settle_eligible_pure_failure; each is one state_transaction.
- New orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay_core.py: constants, PureResultReplayIndexError, PureReplayVisitWitness, build/validate_pure_completion_shell, classify_pure_replay_progress, and the pure functions that mutate a RunState for the four atomic methods. Both StateManager and _CallFrameStateManager call these, so root and child frames share one implementation.
- New pure_result_replay_index.py: derive_pure_result_replay_index, PureResultReplayIndex and PureResultNode. Eligibility: Tarjan SCC over fallthrough and routed transfers, plus for_each/repeat_until bodies, closed through nested loops by _propagate_pure_ineligibility. Bindings are type-walked against the declared binding types, including inactive union members, with exact-ref extraction. Refs are resolved only against the bundle's own runtime-plan keys, so a self/parent/cross-frame ref is dependency_index_invalid. The scope_kind mismatch error carries expected_scope and actual_scope.
- New pure_result_replay.py: PureReplayRuntime (witness, node_id_for_step_id, record_full_result, replay_node, overlay_active_state with cache-hit revalidation, resolve_state_address, required_node_ids_for_boundary, audit_boundary_leaves, audit_progress, audit_persisted_surfaces). It re-exports the public names.
- OutcomeRecorder.persist_step_result(eligible_pure_settlement=witness): success settles the shell, keeps the full result in memory and gives the summary emitter the shell. Failure or skip settles the full row.
- Executor:
  - Eligible pure nodes use begin/reuse visit instead of increment plus start_step, run without the private result bundle (new persist_bundle=False on execute_pure_projection), and skip published-artifact lineage and checkpoint-record emission.
  - Before the prologue, a profiled resume audits surfaces, progress witnesses and boundary leaves, then replays the required pure nodes into an in-memory overlay. profile_conflict is raised. Every other reason fails the run with error.type pure_result_replay_unavailable and error.context.reason.
  - The restart boundary is determined once in execute() and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...) through a cached attribute (see alternatives).
  - The provider observation manager is created at execute() start and closed once. I updated two assertions in tests/test_provider_observation_workflow.py that asserted creation at construction.
- Selection: run.py and resume.py --force-restart pass the profile. The force-restart branch no longer writes the merged observability into the source run's state (that was a write to the source run), so the source stays byte-identical. calls.py selects the profile for a fresh, non-iterative child frame whose callee has provenance.frontend_kind == workflow_lisp; a force-fresh retry has no existing frame, so it selects too. _CallFrameStateManager rejects an existing frame without a mapping state (message contains 'existing call-frame state') before any mkdir or write. load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a detached RunState.
- Checkpoints and default resume: lexical_checkpoint_default_resume filters eligible pure step ids out of the effect points before unique-nearest selection. When no prior durable boundary exists and the state carries the profile, it returns VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY (selection_reason validated_frame_entry_replay, checkpoint_id None) if the progress witnesses and bound-input leaves validate, and otherwise fails closed with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable. capture_restore_payload skips bindings whose source_step_id is an eligible pure node.
- specs/state.md documents the profile. New tests: tests/test_pure_result_replay_profile.py (45 tests) and tests/test_pure_result_replay_runtime.py (18 tests).

VERIFICATION
- The 63 new tests pass. They cover the selector, the shell, a classification table, atomic transactions, OutcomeRecorder, malformed frames, index derivation, a profiled end-to-end run with the same outputs as a historical run, interrupted resume with one restart determination, profile_conflict, a visit-two shell, and missing/invalid bound input.
- Full suite on the final tree: 144 failures in the first run. 139 of them also fail on a clean `git archive HEAD` copy. Of the other 5, two provider-isolation tests are flaky (they passed on rerun) and three subworkflow_calls tests plus one phased-delivery test monkeypatched the executor's default-resume method without a restart_node_id kwarg. I fixed those by keeping the wrapper's (state) signature. A final rerun of the resume/state/call/checkpoint/pure/observation subset (-k) showed no failure that is not in the baseline set. I did not rerun the entire suite after the last small change.

ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED
- Passing restart_node_id as a kwarg on the executor wrapper (discarded, it broke four existing tests that stub the wrapper). I cache the node on the executor and the wrapper forwards it to the planner kwarg.
- Putting everything in one pure_result_replay.py (discarded, CLAUDE.md caps modules at 500 lines), so it is split into core, index and runtime.
- Making every derived_complete pure node replay on resume (discarded). Only nodes reachable from the restart boundary's consumers and the workflow outputs are rebuilt, found by scanning the IR for NodeResultAddress values and root.steps refs.
- Calling the old cursor writer (start_step) for pure visits (discarded, it cannot be made atomic with the visit increment).

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- Details the brief left open are guesses and may differ from the acceptance tests:
  - replay_node's evaluate_node callable is called as (node, overlay), or (node) if it takes one parameter.
  - Typed addresses reuse executable_ir's WorkflowInputAddress and NodeResultAddress.
  - load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a RunState.
  - A scope_kind other than 'root' always raises a mismatch.
- profile_conflict for checkpoint_record and restore_payload, and the VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY default-resume branch, are implemented but have no tests. The available fixtures have no lexical checkpoint points on pure nodes.
- Dependency reasons such as a duplicate projection authority, a cycle and a projection identity mismatch are implemented but not tested. I did not build synthetic bundles for them.
- evaluation_failed, binding_unresolved and output_contract_invalid are mapped from the executor's result error types, but no test forces them.
- Nodes inside for_each/repeat_until bodies and ones reached by goto cycles are excluded by construction. I did not test the multiple_visit_region path on a real loop workflow.
- `orchestrator run` and `resume --force-restart` selection is untested at the CLI level. I only checked that the modules import.
- Nothing is committed.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile: selector field, value-free shell with atomic visit methods, replay index and runtime, resume replay in the executor, and automatic selection for .orc runs, force-restart and fresh Workflow Lisp child frames. Checkpoint-record emission and default-resume are wired only partly and are untested.
